row:
I volunteer at animal shelters in Cyprus and share the sad and happy stories of these poor animals. Join me at the shelter as I give some love to the animals in need. There is a huge problem here in Cyprus with abandoned, abused, and neglected animals. These shelters work to save these animals and to find them their forever homes in nearby countries. I hope to spread the word that adoption is a rewarding choice. 

Some rescue groups I love:

TAKIS SHELTER - A wonderful man in Crete, dedicates his life to rescuing and running a large non-profit shelter. He offers short stay live-in volunteer opportunities if you want to combine a vacation with giving.

ARC - Animal Rescue Corps in Tennessee, called in situations such as puppy mill raids, hoarding, and police involved cruelty cases. Volunteer opportunities.

HOPE FOR PAWS - An angel in California who dedicates his life to rescuing.
